11(a) PROFIT BEFORE TAX
The profit before tax is arrived at after charging
Interest expense
Staff costs (note 11b)
Depreciation on property, plant and equipment (Note 15)
Amortisation of intangible assets (Note 17)
Amortisation of prepaid lease rentals (Note 16)
Impairment losses
Foreign exchange loss
Director’s fees (note 33 (iv))
Other key management emoluments
Auditors’ remuneration

And after crediting:
Interest income
Dividend income
Foreign exchange gain
(Loss)/Gain on disposal of property, plant and equipment
(b) STAFF COSTS
Salaries and wages
Retirement benefits costs
Staff welfare costs

Presented as:
Cost of sales (Note 5)
Administration expenses (Note 8)
